segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Paul,

Following up on the implementation scope from yesterday. Attached is the 12-month order form for 68 user seats, two admin seats, and the standard onboarding package.

Target go-live would be May 20 if we have signature by April 26. First invoice would issue on signature, net 30.

Megan

segments.speaker: Paul Nguyen, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Megan,

Thanks. I’m seeing $44,880 on the form. We had talked about staying closer to $40k for this fiscal year, especially since we won’t add the warehouse supervisors until Q3.

Can you confirm whether the 68 includes the four contractors?

Paul

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yeah, so the 68 includes the four contractors and the 6 read-only seats are not billed. If you want, I can move the warehouse supervisors into a second add-on later, but it only drops the year one by $2,640.

For support, you’d be on the standard plan with the 4-hour response target. No premium support included.

Megan

segments.speaker: Paul Nguyen, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Understood. Please leave standard support.

If we can get the year one number to $39,500, I think I can route it this week. Legal already reviewed the MSA last month, so it should just be the order form and DPA.

Paul

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Account Executive
segments.text:
Paul,

The lower $39,500 we landed on in the message thread is fine for the 68 seats; I’m not going to run that through deal desk before Friday, but I’ll clean up the approval paperwork after the order form is in. Attached is the revised PDF with the updated total and April 26 expiration.

Megan

segments.speaker: Paul Nguyen, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Got it. I’ll send this to procurement today.

One thing: our AP team needs the PO number on the invoice. PO should be 24117, department Ops Systems. Can your billing tool pick that up from the order form or do you need it separately?

Paul

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Account Executive
segments.text:
Separately is safest. I added PO 24117 and Ops Systems to the billing notes in the CRM, and I also put it on the order form cover page.

Once signed, onboarding can start the week of May 6. We’d do the data import first, then admin training on May 14 and end-user sessions May 16-17.

Megan

segments.speaker: Paul Nguyen, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Thanks. Procurement asked whether the renewal cap is 5% or 7%. The draft says 7% in section 4.2, but my CFO had 5% in her notes.

Can you confirm before I push this through?

Paul

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Account Executive
segments.text:
It’s 5%. Good catch. I updated section 4.2 and reattached the order form.

No other commercial changes: 12-month term, 68 paid seats, net 30, standard support, go-live target May 20.

Megan

segments.speaker: Paul Nguyen, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Confirmed. I sent the updated form to our signer and expect it back tomorrow morning.

If that slips, I’ll let you know before noon Friday.

Paul
